gmcm.section.ginger_island.title: Ginger Island Farm Customization
gmcm.section.ginger_island.description: Configure map cleanup and obstacle removal for Ginger Island Farm.
gmcm.remove_farm_driftwood_barrier.name: Remove Farm Driftwood Fence & Logs
gmcm.remove_farm_driftwood_barrier.toolt: Removes the long horizontal driftwood fence and bleached log piles separating the upper path and the farmable field on Ginger Island Farm (Island West).
gmcm.section.farmhouse.title: Farmhouse Customization
gmcm.section.farmhouse.description: Configure farmhouse entrance and doorway enhancements.
gmcm.widen_house_exit.name: 3x1 Farmhouse Exit Doorway
gmcm.widen_house_exit.tooltip: Widens the farmhouse exit doorway to 3 tiles wide across all Farmhouse upgrade levels and the Ginger Island Farmhouse, allowing easy 3x1 exit without being funneled into a single tile.
mod.description: Enhances Stardew Valley maps by widening Farmhouse exit doorways to 3x1 tiles and clearing Ginger Island Farm driftwood fences and log piles.
